metadata.title: झारखंड, ओडिशा, बंगाल और असम के आदिवासियों की दिल्ली दस्तक | Tribal protest at Jantar Mantar
metadata.description: Tribal groups from the states of Jharkhand, West Bengal, Odisha, and Assam have arrived in Delhi to advocate for including the Ho language in the 8th schedule of the Indian constitution. This demand is not new and has also been raised by these communities in the past. The tribal people are seeking official recognition for the Ho language by having it listed in the 8th schedule, granting it the status of a scheduled language alongside other major languages in India. The inclusion of the language in the 8th schedule would signify its importance and contribute to the preservation of the cultural and linguistic identity of these tribal groups. Unfortunately, the Central government has not taken any action on this demand till now.
